title: Where is v8?
description: Compare received WAL with applied data through a permanent cutaway and issue fresh reads on either route.
initialCaption: One write committed v8; the replica query reaches applied v7, while its received WAL waits for replay.
interactionHint: Drag to look around · scroll to zoom
fallback: Single writer, post-commit fresh queries, no cache: received WAL is not yet applied data. Replay changes the queryable state; a new fresh replica read then sees v8. The primary already returns v8. Fixture comparison does not undo a real database.
